p1.title: National Logistics Hub
p1.challenge: A 3PL operator needed to double SKU capacity inside an existing 12,000 sqm shell without expanding the building footprint.
p1.result: Deployed high-density selective and drive-in racking across 9 aisles, engineered around forklift turning radius and fire-code clearances.

p2.title: Retail Distribution Center
p2.challenge: Fast-moving retail SKUs were being hand-stacked on the floor, slowing picking and damaging stock.
p2.result: Installed modular longspan shelving with barcode-ready bin labeling, restructuring the pick path end to end.

p3.title: Cold Chain Facility
p3.challenge: Ground-floor cold storage was at capacity with no land available for horizontal expansion.
p3.result: Engineered a structural steel mezzanine rated for pallet loads, adding a full second storage level.

p4.title: Steel Pipe Storage Yard
p4.challenge: Long steel pipe stock was stored in loose stacks, making inventory counts and retrieval slow and unsafe.
p4.result: Built heavy-duty single and double-sided cantilever racks rated for oversized loads with open-face access.

p5.title: Government Supply Depot
p5.challenge: A multi-million AED government contract required racking rated to strict load and seismic safety standards on a fixed deadline.
p5.result: Delivered and installed certified selective racking across the full depot ahead of the contractual deadline.

p6.title: Automotive Parts Warehouse
p6.challenge: Thousands of small automotive SKUs needed secure, organized storage with fast staff access.
p6.result: Combined boltless shelving with industrial lockers for high-value parts, cutting part-retrieval time significantly.

f1.question: What areas in the UAE do you serve?
f1.answer: We install and support projects across all seven Emirates, with our head office based in Ajman.

f2.question: Do you offer custom racking designs?
f2.answer: Yes. Every project starts with a site survey and a custom engineering design tailored to your load, space and workflow.

f3.question: Can you handle government and large-scale industrial projects?
f3.answer: Absolutely. We have delivered 500+ projects, including multi-million AED government and enterprise contracts.

f4.question: Do your products meet UAE safety and load standards?
f4.answer: All racking and shelving systems are engineered and load-tested to meet UAE industrial safety regulations.

f5.question: What is your typical project timeline?
f5.answer: Depending on scope, projects range from 2 to 12 weeks from design approval to full installation.
